name: facebookresearch_detectron2/projects/DensePose/densepose/modeling/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_detectron2/projects/Den.build_densepose_predictor: build a DensePose predictor instance from a Detectron2 config node and input channel count
facebookresearch_detectron2/projects/Den.build_densepose_data_filter: build a DensePose data filter to select training data from feature tensors and proposals
facebookresearch_detectron2/projects/Den.build_densepose_head: build a DensePose ROI head from a Detectron2 config node and input channel count
facebookresearch_detectron2/projects/Den.build_densepose_losses: build a DensePose loss module from a Detectron2 config node for training
facebookresearch_detectron2/projects/Den.build_densepose_embedder: build a CSE embedder module to embed mesh vertices into an embedding space

facebookresearch_detectron2/projects/Den.create_uv_confidence_config: create a DensePoseUVConfidenceConfig dataclass instance with enabled, epsilon, and type fields for UV confidence
facebookresearch_detectron2/projects/Den.create_segm_confidence_config: create a DensePoseSegmConfidenceConfig dataclass instance with enabled and epsilon fields for segmentation confidence
facebookresearch_detectron2/projects/Den.build_confidence_model_config: build a DensePoseConfidenceModelConfig combining uv_confidence and segm_confidence dataclass instances for confidence models
facebookresearch_detectron2/projects/Den.review_uv_confidence_type_enum: review the DensePoseUVConfidenceType enum with IID_ISO and INDEP_ANISO values for statistical model types
facebookresearch_detectron2/projects/Den.summarize_from_cfg_method: summarize the DensePoseConfidenceModelConfig.from_cfg static method that constructs config from a Detectron2 CfgNode

facebookresearch_detectron2/projects/Den.build_hrfpn_backbone: build an HRFPN backbone from a Detectron2 config with HRNet and ROI head settings
